reports.title: LUMENTUM ANNOUNCES FIRST QUARTER OF FISCAL YEAR 2027 FINANCIAL RESULTS

guidance.heading: Business Outlook
section: Lumentum expects the following for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027:
•Net revenue in the range of $1.575 billion to $1.625 billion
•Non-GAAP diluted earnings per share of $5.90 to $6.20
